bullets.title: “Psychedelic Science: A Conversation with Roland Griffiths” on the Making Sense podcast.
bullets.note: This is one of the best podcast interviews about psychedelics that I’ve ever heard, and I’ve heard a lot. The full episode can also be found (including a great addendum from Sam about his latest personal psilocybin experience) through [the Waking Up app](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/d0u95nv33i0hed6p8hr/deceh0hwzz3d86/aHR0cHM6Ly93YWtpbmd1cC5jb20v), which I’ve used consistently since it launched. Within the app, it’s in the “Theory” section, which you can find in the bottom main menu. You then have to swipe to move from “Lessons” to “Conversations.”

bullets.title: the method
bullets.note: ,** [**basic coffee sock on Amazon**](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/d0u95nv33i0hed6p8hr/z5aghnhr99g5pv/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYW1hem9uLmNvbS9OVU9NSS1GbGFubmVsLUNvZmZlZS1GaWx0ZXItU3RyYWluZXJzL2RwL0IwN0Q4U0tHRksv)**).** I was first introduced to this uber-simple method of coffee brewing in Central America, and I rediscovered it at the coffee wonderland that is [Texas Coffee Traders](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/d0u95nv33i0hed6p8hr/xzbph6hd88gk9v/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cudGV4YXNjb2ZmZWV0cmFkZXJzLmNvbS8=) in Austin, Texas. If their site crashes, here’s their info: 1400 E 4th St., 512.476.2279. Also, in the process of writing this bullet, I found [an entire line extension based on the “sock” approach](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/d0u95nv33i0hed6p8hr/kxhmh6h2gg7z6k/aHR0cHM6Ly9jb2ZmZWVzb2NrLmNvbS8=), which pairs well with the [Able Brewing](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/d0u95nv33i0hed6p8hr/2ou2hoh0rr5l4m/aHR0cHM6Ly9hYmxlYnJld2luZy5jb20vcHJvZHVjdHMvZGlzay1jb2ZmZWUtZmlsdGVy) bullet from a few weeks ago.
